name: licensecc
description: Local orchestration scripts for the Licensecc monorepo.

scripts.check:all: npm run check:pr && npm run test:sdks && npm run check:dry-run && npm run check:docs
scripts.check:dry-run: npm run dry-run --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run dry-run --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run dry-run --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal && npm run dry-run --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-d1-backup
scripts.lint:services: npm run lint --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run lint --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run lint --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal && npm run lint --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-d1-backup
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-typecheck-coverage.mjs && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/licensing-domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal && npm run typecheck --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-d1-backup && npm run test:wrangler-env-drift
scripts.test:backend: npm run test --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run test:sql --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run test:pg --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend
scripts.test:admin: npm run test --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run test:sql --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run test:ui --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin
scripts.test:portal: npm run test --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal && npm run test:ui --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal
scripts.check:schema-parity: npm run schema:parity --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run schema:parity:pg --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend
scripts.test:services: npm run test --workspace @licensecc/licensing-domain && npm run test --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-runtime && npm run test:backend && npm run test:admin && npm run test:portal && npm run test:backup && npm run check:schema-parity
scripts.test:sdks: uv run --directory sdks/python --locked pytest && dotnet test sdks/dotnet/Licensecc.Client.sln && npm run test:java-sdk
scripts.setup:browsers: npm run setup:browsers --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run setup:browsers --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-licensing-backend && npm run test:e2e --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-license-admin && npm run test:e2e --workspace @licensecc/cloudflare-customer-portal
scripts.check:pr: npm run scan:secrets && npm run test:scan:secrets && npm run test:docs-accuracy && npm run test:wrangler-pins && npm run test:clean-checkout && npm run test:workflow-pins && npm run test:repository && npm run check:scripts && npm run test:versions && npm run test:release-artifacts && npm run test:release-operations && npm run check:versions && npm run test:capabilities && npm run check:capabilities && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:hotspots && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:services
